source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1961, p. 7 ("Two new members on Larne Rural Council"); Irish News, 3 May 1961, p. 4; Larne Times, 8 June 1961, p. 3 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Rural District of Larne, 1961")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes and majorities read in the News-Letter report of 3 June 1961; the News-Letter of 2 June had held the Larne results over.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 1 June 1961 in Ardclinis, Eden and Glynn. All 16 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (T. F. W. Nelson, returning officer, Rural Council Office, Prince's Gardens, Larne, dated 2 June 1961; Larne Times, 8 June 1961, p. 3): three polls, ten sole candidates declared elected, and in Ballycorr, Glenarm South and Middle Division the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Contested by two prospective new councillors.
